sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.5.2

  • Bottom Drawer Layout Styling: Enhanced responsive drawer height (82vh), soft backdrop filter overlays, and segment buttons layout.
  • Status One-Tap Cycle: Enabled direct timeline task status updating on tap.
  • Clean Monochromatic Look: Refined list elements to align with Notion/Shopify design directives.
